notes.title: Upcoming update
notes.content:
Hi. Survivors!
Today we have been waiting for a large update.

[code][h1]1. World :[/h1]
Natural disasters are caused by weather.
It is raining and lightning strikes, and typhoons will hit the world in certain seasons.

[h1]2. New tool :[/h1]
A medicinal product that can make a cure.
Tools to catch fireflies.
A lightning rod that blocks lightning.

[h1]3. New structure :[/h1]
Several architectural structures and interior furnishings are updated.
These updated structures can be combined on the worktable.
Build your own architecture by connecting and decorating architectural structures!

[h1]4. New resource :[/h1]
Rocks dropping gold.
A firefly that lights up at night.[/code]

I am sorry to have brought updates news that are too late.
I still believe we will survive in our SUM.ːsteamhappyː
Thank you. See you again before the next update.

notes.title: 1.02 Update notice.
notes.content:
■ Added the option to grab items.
- Change the grip type to Indirect and use the laser by pressing the grip button.

■ Now the tools and food in the inventory are delivered by hand

■ You can check the durability of the tool.

■ You can hunt pigs and rabbits with a spear.

notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
■ Movement method has been added.
- Locomotion

■ You can now select the Go button, the Capture button, and the UI button.

■ Fixed crash when opening SteamVR DashBoard.

■ Fixed an issue where a trap catching birds would only work once.

■ Fixed an issue where Tent does not work in GripOn.
